name: Industry weekly
description: Every Sunday at 18:00 Dubai the Industry Editor writes the CBO's weekly Industry Watch digest from the items filed since the last one: headlines, one section per knowledge category, and what to watch next week. It is filed on the Industry Watch screen and as a note in the vault. The digest is the run's result: set who receives it, by chat and by mail, on the plugin's Settings page.

steps.name: Write the week's digest
steps.description: The Industry Editor writes the digest from what the plugin gathers and files it through the plugin.
steps.instruction: Follow the industry-digest Skill: call `industry_watch_digest_facts`, write each section it lists, and file the digest with `industry_watch_save_digest`. Write nothing any other way and send nothing yourself. Your last reply is delivered as the digest: reply with exactly the markdown the save answered, and nothing else.
